C1467.title: Colonial Pipeline Ransomware Attack
C1467.summary: In May 2021, Colonial Pipeline detected a network intrusion and proactively paused pipeline operations. The FBI attributed the incident to DarkSide ransomware. Public investigations identified the corporate IT network as affected and did not establish that attackers entered pipeline OT controls; nevertheless, the precautionary shutdown disrupted fuel distribution across the U.S. East Coast and contributed to localized shortages and panic buying.
